description: SqliteStore's queries, the same on the three platforms (plan §10.4). Each case opens a new database, migrates it, inserts given.rows table by table in the order given (columns not listed take their defaults; null is SQL NULL; lookup_cache.response, a BLOB, is given as text and stored as its UTF-8 bytes), then makes given.call with given.args and checks the result by ids (or the fields listed). The store's clock says 2026-10-04T12:00:00.000Z. Each platform also checks that every record type it writes reads back equal (a database is never shared between platforms, so the JSON columns needn't be byte-identical across them).

expect.rule: unfinished; acquisition, processing, maintenance; then position, then created_at
the library; the name contains the text, ignoring case; the state; newest first
committed units; never checked first (oldest first), then by their latest check
oldest first; items in seq order
committed units with the fingerprint, newest commit first
committed TV units (success or errors) of the same set (EpisodeContinuation.sameSet) whose disc is one lower; the one with the highest episode
the highest episode of any committed disc of the same set
the title contains the text, ignoring case; by title, ignoring case
unsent, next attempt at or before now, soonest first; no next attempt means given up
an answer is returned until it expires (the store's clock says 2026-10-04T12:00:00.000Z)
